title: Experiments: the plan before running
intro: Loading a combination fills the plan: what changes, the values tested, how they are combined, the weather and soil, the years and the results saved. The size of the experiment is shown before anything is run.

marks.d: Where the plan comes from: the reference manual, your request or the built-in planner.
The values can be typed over; the allowed range is shown beside them.
Takes the row out of the experiment.
Every combination, one thing at a time, or paired.
How much Daisy writes: yearly totals only, with harvest, with daily values, or everything.
Number of runs and the time they take.
